uncited: Ray Segments Spec is a data structure designed to represent ray segments efficiently, particularly in the context of volume rendering and neural radiance fields.
It stores segment values, endpoint flags, validity, chunking information, and ray mappings.

It differs from sibling structures like [Ray Bundle](2179-ray-bundle.md) by focusing on explicit segment-level metadata rather than raw ray parameters, and from [RayBatch container](4187-raybatch-container.md) by providing granular control over segment validity and chunking.
The structure relies on parallel arrays to store segment data, enabling efficient indexing and filtering.
This layout supports sparse and structured data access patterns common in volume rendering pipelines.
It facilitates efficient rendering by organizing segments into chunks and managing validity flags.
